questions.prompt: Which empire built an extensive road network centered on Cusco?
questions.fact: The road network ran for tens of thousands of kilometres, worked by relay runners who could carry a message hundreds of miles in a day.

questions.prompt: How many chambers does a human heart have?
questions.fact: Two atria collect blood and two ventricles pump it out — one side to the lungs, the other to the rest of the body.

questions.prompt: Which winter sport involves sliding stones toward a target on ice?
questions.fact: Sweepers melt a thin film of water ahead of the stone, which lets them steer it several metres after release.

questions.prompt: Which island is the largest in the Mediterranean Sea?
questions.fact: It holds Mount Etna, Europe's most active volcano, which erupts often enough to be part of ordinary life there.

questions.prompt: Which novel is narrated by a character called Nick Carraway?
questions.fact: He opens by claiming he reserves all judgements, then spends the novel judging everyone. That gap is the point.

questions.prompt: Which programming language was created by Guido van Rossum?
